An FSB agent and a BEAR operator investigated a guy they call "The Supervisor" together, a UNTAR officer in charge of one of the evacuation gates.

The records we have say they stopped somewhere in the offices at Factory, and haven't been seen since.

Turn that place upside down, but find something.

6a680e36dc45fd15657209c2 description:
If there is one truth in Tarkov, it is that despite what the authorities and UNTAR say, Tarkov is no longer under control. For all these years, the world believed this was a war for survival. Fools.

There are PMCs, civilians, and a lot of people who just want to get out of this hellhole, and we will make sure that happens. But for those who found in Tarkov a place merely to cause chaos, profit, and have fun with the destruction... that is ending soon!

I've received dozens more calls from UNTAR officers and haven't answered a single one because this will be the final blow before we prepare to expose every single one of their lies. My people prepared a high-frequency broadcast in multiple languages; we will broadcast for an entire day on all types of radios across Tarkov, warning everyone to stay in their hideouts. We'll prepare various humanitarian operations with supplies and medics.

Whoever leaves their respective bases, we know what they're looking for. More conflict, more war, and not survival, and everyone who steps out will fall, one by one.

Plant another long-range transmitter on the radio tower on Shoreline; my engineers will do the rest. After that, I need you to repair the tower on Woods; it will be enough to amplify the range across all of Tarkov.

See you later!
